items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: Like with Tony Bennett “San Francisco,” he has to sing that every show for the past 50 years.

ctx.x: Yeah he didn’t seem like a tall person.

He was six foot two, oh yeah. And I still love to play. I never get bored playing. If I have to play a song four or five times a night it doesn’t bother me, I’ll play it at different tempos or I’ll play it in a different key. I know how to get around little things like that. If I have to play a song like “As Time Goes By,” I can play it like —[Sol plays] — or if I have to play it again I’ll play it — [Sol plays] — you know to give it a little twist. Like with Tony Bennett “San Francisco,” he has to sing that…
Right. The clarinet seems to be one of the harder instruments to play.
